rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site aggregated dataset; eleven datasets combined.
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "Eleven datasets were combined to create the full sample."

rci2_using_epd.detail: Public datasets include Cam-CAN, IXI, OASIS3, and NKI-Rockland (among others).
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "We included healthy participants from ten publicly available datasets: the Amsterdam Open MRI Collection (aomic) (id1000, piop1 and piop2) datasets, the Cambridge Centre for Ageing and Neuroscience (camcan) dataset, the Dallas Longitudinal Brain Study (dlbs) dataset, the Information eXtraction from Images (ixi) dataset (http://braindevelopment.org/ixidataset/), the Narratives (narratives) dataset, the Open Access Series of Imaging Studies (oasis3) dataset, the NKI-Rockland (rockland) dataset and the Southwest University adult lifespan (sald) dataset."

rci3_epd_name.detail: Cambridge Centre for Ageing and Neuroscience (camcan), Information eXtraction from Images (ixi), NKI-Rockland (rockland), and Open Access Series of Imaging Studies (oasis3).
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "We included healthy participants from ten publicly available datasets: the Amsterdam Open MRI Collection (aomic) (id1000, piop1 and piop2) datasets, the Cambridge Centre for Ageing and Neuroscience (camcan) dataset, the Dallas Longitudinal Brain Study (dlbs) dataset, the Information eXtraction from Images (ixi) dataset (http://braindevelopment.org/ixidataset/), the Narratives (narratives) dataset, the Open Access Series of Imaging Studies (oasis3) dataset, the NKI-Rockland (rockland) dataset and the Southwest University adult lifespan (sald) dataset."

rci5_n.detail: Training set of healthy participants across datasets; test set reported separately.
rci5_n.supporting_text: "The training set included 4310 participants and the test set 859 participants."
rci5_n.location: study_1/Janssen2024.pdf.md: Normative modeling of morphometric similarity / Materials and Methods

rci6_sex.detail: Training-phase sex breakdown not directly reported. Estimated from per-dataset sex percentages in Fig. 1 table, weighted by approximate training contribution (~90% of each of the 10 public datasets; ~20% of clinical HC N=292, 44.5%F per Table 1A). Stratified split preserved sex distribution within each dataset. female_n and male_n sum to 4310 (paper-stated training N).
rci6_sex.supporting_text: "The per-dataset splits were created using the createDataPartition function from the caret R package, preserving the distribution of age, sex, and scanner (some datasets contained multiple scanners) in both the training and the test split of each dataset."
rci6_sex.location: Janssen2024.pdf.md: Fig. 1 table; Table 1A; Materials and Methods / Normative modeling of morphometric similarity

rci7_age.detail: Training-phase age statistics not directly reported. Weighted mean and pooled SD computed from per-dataset statistics in Fig. 1 table (10 public HC datasets, total N=4710) and Table 1A (clinical HC training: ~58 subjects, mean 30.44, SD 11.02). Pooled SD accounts for both within-dataset and between-dataset variance. Min/max not stated for the training set. Age in years.
rci7_age.supporting_text: "The per-dataset splits were created using the createDataPartition function from the caret R package, preserving the distribution of age, sex, and scanner ... in both the training and the test split of each dataset." Per-dataset age (mean (SD)): aomic_id1000 22.85 (1.71), aomic_piop1 22.18 (1.80), aomic_piop2 21.96 (1.79), camcan 54.53 (18.48), dlbs 54.09 (19.91), ixi 50.82 (16.15), narratives 21.92 (4.66), oasis3 69.44 (8.75), rockland 39.70 (22.96), sald 45.18 (17.44).
rci7_age.location: Janssen2024.pdf.md: Fig. 1 table; Table 1A; Materials and Methods / Normative modeling of morphometric similarity
